metadata.title: On the completeness of gravitational pp-wave spacetimes: A counterexample to the {Ehlers--Kundt} conjecture
metadata.abstract: This paper concerns the geometry of gravitational pp-wave spacetimes. We give a counterexample to the Ehlers--Kundt conjecture. In fact, we show that geodesic completeness is generic, in the sense of Baire category, among gravitational pp-waves. We also define a concept of ``universal pp-wave'', i.e. a pp-wave whose metric approximates that of every other gravitational pp-wave arbitrarily closely on arbitrarily large compact sets, and we show that there are geodesically complete universal pp-waves. Our machinery also suffices to give a new proof of the polynomial case of the Ehlers--Kundt conjecture (previously proved by Flores and Sánchez).

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 经典猜想反例与 Baire 泛性
analysis.workSummary: 作者声明构造 Ehlers–Kundt 猜想的反例，并证明引力 pp-wave 中测地完备性在 Baire 范畴意义下是泛性的；还构造测地完备的通用 pp-wave。
analysis.breakthrough: 若全部假设和证明成立，会改变完备 pp-wave 必须具有特定形式的传统预期；同一方法还重证多项式情形。
analysis.limitations: 主定理在四维 Ricci 平坦 pp-wave 中使用非二次整函数；泛性拓扑为紧集一致收敛或 u 方向光滑收敛。未独立验证 Baire 构造和全局测地线控制。 已补读正文引言、主定理及方法说明；未逐步复核全部证明。AI 披露另见独立核查记录。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者在第 5 页明确声明所有想法来自人类，同时使用 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Sonnet 5 生成图、检查证明、检索文献、编辑并撰写部分文本。此处归类为计算制图、论证检查、文献和写作辅助，不归因核心想法或证明生成。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.30419v1 · 第 5 页，1.4 Statement on AI usage
